title: Northgate Card Refund Bonus on Add-On Card Fee Refunds
content:
**Tender benefit.** On Northgate Memberships business memberships, an add-on fee charged to a Northgate Rewards Visa earns a Northgate card refund bonus of four percent of the share, one charged to a Northgate Store Card earns two percent, and one charged to any other tender earns none. The removed card refund share is increased by the bonus percentage of that share and rounded to the cent.

The tender is the one recorded on the add-on fee charge of the removed card (the cards are Northgate Credit Cards products).

| Tender of the add-on fee charge | Northgate card refund bonus |
|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards Visa | 4 percent of the share |
| Northgate Store Card | 2 percent of the share |
| debit card or cash, other credit card, Northgate Shop Card, Annual Reward certificate | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical shares)

| Share | Tender of the add-on fee charge | Working | Share with bonus |
|---|---|---|---|
| 54.17 | Northgate Rewards Visa | 54.17 increased by 4 percent of 54.17 (2.1668) is 56.3368 | 56.34 |
| 65.00 | Northgate Store Card | 65.00 increased by 2 percent of 65.00 (1.30) | 66.30 |
| 32.50 | other credit card | no bonus | 32.50 |
